validation: leave-one-test-out, out-of-fold P(burn) of the shipped model

definitions.burn_recall: share of NASA burn points called 'burn' (P(burn) >= threshold)
definitions.miss_rate: share of NASA burn points called 'won't burn' (1 - burn recall)
definitions.false_safe_rate: share of 'won't burn' calls that were NASA burn points
definitions.extinguished_recall: share of NASA extinguished points called 'won't burn'

readout_rule: verdict BURN if P(burn) >= 0.5 (unchanged); the readout also flags 'may burn' when the safety threshold <= P(burn) < 0.5
